Attribute.Name: Address Status
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="if(
    and(
        value('MDM_AddressEndDate')!='',
        ConvertDateToDayNumber(
            formatdatetime(
                now(),
                'YYY-MM-dd'
            )
        )>ConvertDateToDayNumber(
            value('MDM_AddressEndDate')
        )
    ),
    'PAST',
    if(
        and(
            value('MDM_AddressStartDate')!='',
            ConvertDateToDayNumber(
                formatdatetime(
                    now(),
                    'YYY-MM-dd'
                )
            )<ConvertDateToDayNumber(
                value('MDM_AddressStartDate')
            )
        ),
        'FUTURE',
        'CURRENT'
    )
)"/>
